meta.thesis: Virtuoso is transitioning from a single-product, low-margin AC OEM into a diversified consumer-durable EMS/contract-manufacturer across four segments (LED EMS, AC, refrigeration/deep-freezers, compressors). The two structural drivers are (a) the move from OEM → ODM in AC (margin protection + new customer wins) and (b) a first-mover position in domestic reciprocating compressors for refrigerators
